notes:
Beta 1.5.12 - server-managed verification badges.

What changed:
- Added VPS badge API and a Telegram admin bot for issuing, editing, listing, and deleting badges.
- Badges can target users and channels, with custom premium emoji id plus verification text.
- Plugin now fetches server badges and applies them to User, UserFull, Chat, and ChatFull objects.
- Badge changes are polled live and repatch the visible profile; deletions sync as disabled tombstones so clients can clear cached visual badges.

Verified: py_compile, git diff --check.
